name: Short-Cut Lentil, Sun-Dried Tomato, Spinach & Gouda Quesadilla with Onion Dip

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse lentils in a colander. Pat dry with paper towels and place in a medium bowl. Add pesto, salt, and pepper, then stir to combine the lentil filling. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (15 oz) can lentils
½ cup sun-dried tomato pesto
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Stack cheese slices one on top of another, then cut crosswise to yield 16 pieces. Set aside.
Preheat 2 large skillets over medium heat.

While the skillets heat up, arrange tortillas on a flat surface. Place 2 pieces of cheese on one half of each tortilla; layer with lentil filling, spinach, and remaining pieces of cheese. Fold in half to close (the quesadillas will be very full, but will shrink down as they cook).

Once the skillets are hot, add 1 teaspoon oil to each and swirl to coat the bottom. Place 2 assembled quesadillas in each skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden, about 2 minutes per side. Remove to a plate.
To serve, cut quesadillas in half and divide between plates. Serve with onion dip on the side. Enjoy!
